body:
Shell-ish whitespace-split tokens, quotes respected, parens group
internal whitespace. Flags include:

- Global: `filter`, `search`, `sort=<col>[:asc|desc]` (comma-separated
  for multi), `hide=<col>,…`, `delimiter=<char>`, `header`, `src=<path>`,
  `height=<px>`, `title=<text>`, `sticky-header`, `row-numbers`,
  `id-column=<col>`, `agg:<col>=<fn>`, `freeze=<col>,…`,
  `density=compact|comfy|relaxed`, `selection`, `group-by=<col>`,
  `expandable`, `url-sync`, `width:<col>=<px>`.
- Per-column: `type:<col>=<type-expr>`, `align:<col>=<left|right|center>`,
  `width:<col>=<px>`.
- Type expressions take optional parens with args, e.g.
  `status(P0:danger,P1:warn)`, `currency(USD)`, `progress(0:100)`,
  `rating(10)`, `tags(|)`, `sparkline(line|bar|area)`, `duration(s|ms|m|h)`,
  `range(<sep>)`.
